topic: Adjusting analytics data granularity for client
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on technical issues with the staging analytics dashboard and subsequent data requirements. Initially, a strange glitch was noted on the staging environment for traffic metrics (facility 3468). Later, a request was made to recalculate the dashboard data granularity from a 2-hour gap to a 15-minute interval for 'Mol' (a specific location/client area).

The technical feasibility of this change requires performing a full data reaggregation rather than just an analytics redeploy. The scope of the required cluster dataset was narrowed down to only include data for 'AFs'.
decisions: The dashboard data granularity needs recalculation from 2-hour gaps to 15-minute intervals.
The necessary reaggregation (cluster dataset) will be limited to data for AFs.
action_items: Someone will perform the required data reaggregation and update the dashboard metrics by the next day.
